t: The Erbauer multi-material 113 piece drill bit set provides a comprehensive solution for diverse drilling and screwdriving applications. This kit is engineered for high performance across various materials, including wood, metal, and masonry, making it an essential addition for electricians, plumbers, and tradespeople. The set includes a wide array of HSS drill bits, masonry drill bits, brad point wood drill bits, flat wood bits, and numerous screwdriver bits, alongside nut drivers, for extensive versatility. All components are securely organised within a sturdy polypropylene carry case; compatible with the Erbauer Connecx stacking system for efficient storage.
b: Contents: 13 HSS Bits, 5 Masonry Bits, 13 Brad Point Bits, 3 Flat Wood Bits, 8 Nut Drivers, 60 Driver Bits, Bit Holder, Countersink, 2 Hole Saws, Holesaw Arbour, 3 Drill Stoppers, Extension Bar, Drill
Suitable Can be Used with Rotary & Impact Modes
Compatible with Most Power Tool Brands
